name: Point Of Interaction
definition: Point of interaction (POI) is the entry point to a card payment system. It could be a physical or logical card payment terminal containing software and hardware components, it could be a payment system including a set of card payment terminals linked to a local or remote server, or it could be just an interface to make payments as telephone or Internet browser.

CardReadingCapabilities.name: Card Reading Capabilities
CardReadingCapabilities.definition: Card reading capabilities of the POI performing the transaction.

CardholderVerificationCapabilities.name: Cardholder Verification Capabilities
CardholderVerificationCapabilities.definition: Type of cardholder verification that could be performed during a transaction.

OnLineCapabilities.name: On Line Capabilities
OnLineCapabilities.definition: On-line and off-line capabilities of the POI.

PrintLineWidth.name: Print Line Width
PrintLineWidth.definition: Number of columns of the printer component.

Component.name: Component
Component.definition: Type of components belonging to a POI.

ComponentIdentification.name: Component Identification
ComponentIdentification.definition: Identification of the POI component assigned by its provider.

GroupIdentifier.name: Group Identifier
GroupIdentifier.definition: Identifier assigned by the merchant identifying a set of POI terminals performing some categories of transactions.

LineWidth.name: Line Width
LineWidth.definition: Number of columns of the display component.

NumberOfLines.name: Number Of Lines
NumberOfLines.definition: Number of lines of the display component.

ErrorLog.name: Error Log
ErrorLog.definition: Error logging transferred by the point of interaction to the terminal management system.

ComponentVersionNumber.name: Component Version Number
ComponentVersionNumber.definition: Identification of a version of component belonging to a given model.

CardPaymentAcquiring.name: Card Payment Acquiring
CardPaymentAcquiring.definition: Process which uses the point of interaction.

ControllingTerminalManagementSystem.name: Controlling Terminal Management System
ControllingTerminalManagementSystem.definition: Terminal management system for which a point of interaction is specified.
